prompt: A hyper-realistic, wide-angle photograph of a colossal bipedal police robot standing in the middle of a busy Tokyo intersection on an overcast day. The robot is approximately 15 meters tall, constructed with heavy-duty industrial machinery featuring exposed black hydraulic pistons, cabling, and white armored plating. It has a blocky head equipped with multiple camera lenses and sensor arrays. Red emergency strobe lights are mounted on its shoulders and chest. The text "警視庁 MPD" (Metropolitan Police Department) is clearly printed in black on the white armor plates of its chest, thighs, and shins. The robot is actively holding a long, silver metal crowd-control barricade fence with its left hand, positioning it across the road to seal off the area. In the foreground, several human police officers wearing dark blue uniforms, reflective vests, and white helmets are directing traffic; one officer on the left holds an orange baton, while another on the right gestures towards the robot. The background features realistic Japanese street signage, including a large blue overhead sign pointing to "Shinjuku," "Ginza," and "Tokyo Sta." A vertical banner on a building to the left reads "ともに守る。東京の未来" (Protecting together. Tokyo's future). The scene includes wet asphalt reflecting the cloudy sky, orange traffic cones, and distant city skyscrapers.

promptZh: 这是一张超写实的广角照片，画面中一台巨大的双足警用机器人矗立在阴天里繁忙的东京十字路口中央。该机器人大约 15 米高，由重型工业机械构成，外露的黑色液压活塞、线缆和白色装甲板清晰可见。它拥有一个方正的头部，配备了多个摄像头镜头和传感器阵列。肩膀和胸部安装有红色紧急频闪灯。其胸部、大腿和小腿的白色装甲板上清晰地印有黑色文字“警視庁 MPD”（警视厅）。机器人正用左手持握一道长长的银色金属人群控制路障围栏，将其横置于道路上以封锁区域。前景中，几名身穿深蓝色制服、反光背心并佩戴白色头盔的人类警察正在指挥交通；左侧一名警察手持橙色指挥棒，右侧另一名警察则向机器人做出手势。背景中有逼真的日本街道标识，包括一块指向“新宿”、“银座”和“东京站”的大型蓝色 overhead 指示牌。左侧建筑物上悬挂着一条垂直横幅，上面写着“ともに守る。東京の未来”（共同守护。东京的未来）。场景中还包括反射着阴云天空的潮湿沥青路面、橙色交通锥以及远处的城市摩天大楼。
